description: cachekeeper: before a /model or picker switch forfeits a warm prompt cache, ask with the size of the loss, then ask whether the next request should run in a subagent on that model; log every switch for `cachekeeper events`; keep a long session's cache warm while its user is away, on by default (CACHEKEEPER_KEEPALIVE=0 turns it off).

hooks.command:
echo `# <#` >/dev/null; f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; sh "$f" pre-model-switch; exit 0
#> > $null; $f = "$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/run.ps1"; if (-not [IO.File]::Exists($f)) { exit 0 }; & $f pre-model-switch; exit 0

echo `# <#` >/dev/null; f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; sh "$f" post-model-switch; exit 0
#> > $null; $f = "$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/run.ps1"; if (-not [IO.File]::Exists($f)) { exit 0 }; & $f post-model-switch; exit 0

echo `# <#` >/dev/null; f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; sh "$f" user-prompt-submit; exit 0
#> > $null; $f = "$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/run.ps1"; if (-not [IO.File]::Exists($f)) { exit 0 }; & $f user-prompt-submit; exit 0

echo `# <#` >/dev/null; f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; sh "$f" stop; [ $? -eq 75 ] && exit 2; exit 0
#> > $null; $f = "$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/run.ps1"; if (-not [IO.File]::Exists($f)) { exit 0 }; & $f stop; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 75) { exit 2 }; exit 0
